enhance_definition: A measurable reliability, recovery, verification, generalization, artifact-truthfulness, or debugging-speed improvement that does not weaken the strong current Safari/macOS runtime core.

candidates.name: Wikipedia
candidates.why: Low-risk real site that directly exercises the current Safari/macOS runtime for navigation, extraction, and verification.

candidates.name: Hacker News
candidates.why: Simple text-heavy live site that is ideal for clean navigation and DOM/a11y/screenshot agreement tests.

candidates.name: Google Maps
candidates.why: Good dynamic-site stress test after Wikipedia and HN, but more volatile and JS-heavy.

candidates.name: VisualWebArena
candidates.why: Best benchmark family match for this repo because the project is already screenshot/vision heavy.

candidates.name: WebArena
candidates.why: Strong repeatable browser-agent benchmark, but should be kept separate from the current OS-native runtime path.

candidates.name: BrowserGym
candidates.why: Useful as a harness once benchmark integration becomes a real branch, not as the first operational target.

candidates.name: Mind2Web
candidates.why: Strong for offline generalization and plan-quality evaluation, not the first live Safari integration target.

candidates.name: Surf.new
candidates.why: Useful for inspiration or quick experimentation, but weak as a scientific benchmark for this repo.
